description: Run a raw SoQL query against any Los Angeles open-data resource (data.lacity.org) by its Socrata id (8-char like "2nrs-mtv8"). Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use la_datasets to find a resource id, or la_recent for the common ones.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: la_query
